Captopril is an ACE inhibitor that directly acts on the RAAS by inhibiting the conversion of angiotensin I to angiotensin II. Eplerenone is an aldosterone antagonist that also directly acts on the RAAS by blocking the effects of aldosterone. Aliskiren is a direct renin inhibitor that reduces the formation of angiotensin I, thus directly acting on the RAAS. Minoxidil, a vasodilator, relaxes vascular smooth muscle and does not act on the RAAS. Therefore, the drugs that do NOT act on the renin-angiotensin-aldosterone system are Atenolol and Minoxidil.
